segments.text: In the next minute, we add a new customer and place their first order.
We sign in with our user name and password.
The customer list shows everyone we sell to. We start a new entry from the top right.
We type the company name and its order e-mail, and save. The new customer appears in the list.
Now we open the customer and add an order. We pick a product, set the quantity to ten, and confirm.
That is all it takes. A new customer and their first order, in a few clicks.
